Fill in the blank (Appropriate Filler),.option4: ঘ) yet some are not undergoing practices.

Fill in the blank (Appropriate Filler),.question:
১৭) In this question, a part of the sentence is made bold. Below are given alternatives to the bold part at (A), (B), (C) and (D) which may improve the sentence.(17-40)
Parliamentary rules and procedures government conduct in business don’t allow sloganeering in any form inside the chamber.
Fill in the blank (Appropriate Filler),.exp:
লাইভ পরীক্ষায় অপশন D তে টাইপিং ভুল ছিল। তাই, উত্তর বাতিল করা হয়েছে।
We can infer that parliamentary rules and procedures which govern how business is conducted do not allow sloganeering inside the chamber. Therefore, ‘governing’ should be used instead of ‘government’ in the given context of the sentence.
Moreover, here ‘conduct’ means ‘carrying out’, i.e. how business should be carried out. Therefore, instead of the preposition ‘in’, ‘of’ should be used here so as to make the sentence correct.
Correct Sentence: Parliamentary rules and procedures governing conduct of business don’t allow sloganeering in any form inside the chamber.

Fill in the blank (Appropriate Filler),.question: ১৮) The weather office has stood up their initial forecast of monsoon rainfall being 96% of average in the June-September season.
Fill in the blank (Appropriate Filler),.option1: ক) stand by their initial forecast of
Fill in the blank (Appropriate Filler),.option2: খ) stood by its initial forecast of
Fill in the blank (Appropriate Filler),.option3: গ) stand by its initial forecast of
Fill in the blank (Appropriate Filler),.option4: ঘ) stood up its initial forecast of
Fill in the blank (Appropriate Filler),.exp:
There are two errors in the bold part.
Firstly, the phrasal verb ‘stand by’ which means ‘adhere to or abide by (something promised, stated, or decided)’ has been written incorrectly. Therefore, ‘stood up’ must be replaced by ‘stood by’ in order to make the sentence correct.
Secondly, usage of plural case of possessive pronoun ‘their’ is also erroneous. Here the writer refers to the weather office which is a single institution. Therefore, ‘their’ should be replaced by ‘its’ to make it a grammatically correct sentence.

Fill in the blank (Appropriate Filler),.question: ১৯) Whatever the outcome, the momentum in buying gold is unlikely to half anytime soon.
Fill in the blank (Appropriate Filler),.option1: ক) are unlikely to half anytime
Fill in the blank (Appropriate Filler),.option2: খ) is unlikely in halving anytime
Fill in the blank (Appropriate Filler),.option3: গ) is unlikely to have halved anytime
Fill in the blank (Appropriate Filler),.exp: The original sentence is absolutely correct and hence the bold part needs no replacement.

Fill in the blank (Appropriate Filler),.question: ২০) One school of thought believes that the planet is warming without humans doing anything to make it happen.
Fill in the blank (Appropriate Filler),.option1: ক) the planet is warming it
Fill in the blank (Appropriate Filler),.option2: খ) the planet is warming itself
Fill in the blank (Appropriate Filler),.option3: গ) the planet is warming themselves
Fill in the blank (Appropriate Filler),.option4: ঘ) the planet is warming oneself
Fill in the blank (Appropriate Filler),.exp: The reflexive pronoun ‘itself’ is missing in the given sentence. Reflexive pronouns reflect the action back onto the subject. A reflexive pronoun should be used with a transitive verb and it can never be used as a subject in a sentence. Hence ‘itself’ should be used after ‘warming’ in order to make the sentence grammatically correct.

Fill in the blank (Appropriate Filler),.question: ২১) A dollar weak index and lower US treasury yield are also making the yellow metal attractive for investors.
Fill in the blank (Appropriate Filler),.option1: ক) dollar weaker index and lower US
Fill in the blank (Appropriate Filler),.option2: খ) dollar weak index and low US
Fill in the blank (Appropriate Filler),.option3: গ) weak dollar index and US lower
Fill in the blank (Appropriate Filler),.option4: ঘ) weak dollar index and lower US
Fill in the blank (Appropriate Filler),.exp: The writer is referring to the ‘dollar index’. The U.S. Dollar Index is an index (or measure) of the value of the United States dollar relative to a basket of foreign currencies. According to the given sentence, the dollar index has become weak. Therefore, a ‘weak dollar index’ should be used here instead of ‘dollar weak index’ so as to make the sentence correct.

Fill in the blank (Appropriate Filler),.question: ২২) Entrepreneurs should put down some money in a contingency fund even before starting their business.
Fill in the blank (Appropriate Filler),.option1: ক) should putting down some money
Fill in the blank (Appropriate Filler),.option2: খ) should put by some money
Fill in the blank (Appropriate Filler),.option3: গ) should have put down some money
Fill in the blank (Appropriate Filler),.option4: ঘ) should had put by some money
Fill in the blank (Appropriate Filler),.exp:
Usage of the phrasal verb ‘put down’ which means ‘suppress’ is inappropriate in this sentence.
‘Put by’ which means ‘lay aside for time of need’ would be suitable in this context.
E.g: I try to put by some money every month.
Hence ‘put aside’ should be used in place of ‘put down’ to make the sentence grammatically and contextually correct.
Among the given choices, only option B replaces the given bold part most appropriately.
The sentence after replacement becomes:
Entrepreneurs should put by some money in a contingency fund even before starting their business.

Fill in the blank (Appropriate Filler),.question: ২৩) We must do everything we possibly can sooner than we think we can, and more brilliantly and imaginatively than we think possible.

Fill in the blank (Appropriate Filler),.option2: খ) later than we think we can
Fill in the blank (Appropriate Filler),.option3: গ) latest than we think we can
Fill in the blank (Appropriate Filler),.exp: The original sentence is absolutely correct and hence the bold part needs no replacement.

Fill in the blank (Appropriate Filler),.question: ২৪) Most of us recognise our moral obligation towards leave children a decent future, which obviously includes a decent planet.
Fill in the blank (Appropriate Filler),.exp:
The word ‘obligation’ must be followed the preposition ‘to’ instead of ‘towards’ in this context. The word ‘obligation’ means ‘duty or commitment’.
Hence, the preposition ‘to’ should be used in place of ‘towards’ in order to make the sentence grammatically and contextually correct.

Fill in the blank (Appropriate Filler),.question: ২৫) A student was arrested for displaying an indecently art work in public.
Fill in the blank (Appropriate Filler),.exp:
‘Art work’ is a noun phrase, before which an appropriate adjective should be used.
The underlined part ‘indecently’, which is an adverb, hence must be replaced with the adjective ‘indecent’ to make it a grammatically correct sentence.

Fill in the blank (Appropriate Filler),.question: ২৬) He did not like me to smoking in the presence of our teacher yesterday.
Fill in the blank (Appropriate Filler),.exp:
The underlined part ‘me to smoking’ must be replaced with ‘my smoking’ to make it a grammatically correct sentence.
As per the basic usage rules, ‘like’ is one of the verbs which are followed by a gerund e.g. swimming, dancing or traveling, etc.
Since the gerund is a noun, it is logical to find it preceded by a possessive pronoun (his, her, your, my, our, etc) or a noun in the possessive form (Rohan’s, Mr. Sharma’s, etc)

Fill in the blank (Appropriate Filler),.question: ২৮) The scenery around the hill station of Himachal Pradesh is quite picturesque and enjoyed.
Fill in the blank (Appropriate Filler),.exp: The word ‘enjoyed’ must be replaced with the adjective ‘enjoyable’ to make it a grammatically correct sentence.

Fill in the blank (Appropriate Filler),.question: ২৯) Within three years, he demonstrated a dramatic improved business performance.
Fill in the blank (Appropriate Filler),.exp:
In the sentence the word before the phrase ‘improved business performance’ must be an adverb as it has to add information to the adjective ‘improved’.

Fill in the blank (Appropriate Filler),.question: ৩০) Considering the high demand for flights to Gulf countries airlines, can risen prices.
Fill in the blank (Appropriate Filler),.exp:
As the context in the sentence suggests a possibility, use of the modal ‘may’ would be appropriate and as it is followed by the base form of a verb, ‘rise’ instead of ‘risen’ will be used here.
The underlined part ‘can risen’, therefore, must be replaced with ‘may rise’ to make it a grammatically correct sentence.

Fill in the blank (Appropriate Filler),.question: ৩১) Without both issue is clarified the board will keep all other matters before it pending.
Fill in the blank (Appropriate Filler),.exp:
As the sentence is a type 1 conditional sentence, use of ‘Unless’ which means ‘Except on the condition that’ instead of ‘Without’ will be more appropriate.
Second, as ‘both’ suggests ‘two’, the noun that is followed by it must be in plural form.
The correct formation will be – “Unless both issues are clarified, the board will keep all other matters before it pending.

Fill in the blank (Appropriate Filler),.question: ৩২) The incident has clearly highlighted his knowledge and attentive of detail.
Fill in the blank (Appropriate Filler),.exp:
In this sentence, the predicate part followed by “..his knowledge and …” has to be a noun phrase and hence the adjective ‘attentive’ must be replaced with the noun ‘attention’.
And at the same time, it’s more appropriate and common to use ‘to’ after ‘attention’ and not ‘of’. The correct formation, hence, will be- The incident has clearly highlighted his knowledge and attention to detail.

Fill in the blank (Appropriate Filler),.question: ৩৩) The bank’s accumulated losses have come up for manageable levels this year.
Fill in the blank (Appropriate Filler),.exp:
‘Come up for something’ means ‘to be eligible for something’ or ‘to be in line or sequence for something’.
Ex. She came up for re-election in June.
Hence, the use of ‘come up for’ in the given context is erroneous. While, ‘come to’, which means ‘to attain, achieve or reach something’, will be an appropriate choice to make the sentence correct.

Fill in the blank (Appropriate Filler),.question: ৩৪) Improving the educational system, which is one of the worst in the world, requires commitment from the country’s politicians.
Fill in the blank (Appropriate Filler),.exp: Improving the educational system, which is one of the worst in the world, requires commitment from the country’s politicians. The sentence is absolutely correct.

Fill in the blank (Appropriate Filler),.question: ৪৩) Since one cannot read every book, one should be content with making a _________ selection.

Fill in the blank (Appropriate Filler),.question: ৪৪) Some people _________ themselves into believing that they are indispensable to the organization they work for.
Fill in the blank (Appropriate Filler),.exp: The word delude is the most effective word, which can make the sentence meaningful.“Some people delude themselves into believing that they are indispensable to the organization they work for.”

Fill in the blank (Appropriate Filler),.question: ৪৫) How do you expect that country to progress when her government is corrupt, _________ and still largely feudal?
Fill in the blank (Appropriate Filler),.exp: The word despotic is the most effective word, which can make the sentence meaningful. “How do you expect that country to progress when her government is corrupt, despotic and still largely feudal?”

Fill in the blank (Appropriate Filler),.question: ৪৬) His interest in the study of human behaviour is indeed very _________.

Fill in the blank (Appropriate Filler),.question: ৪৭) The improvement made by changes in the system was _________ and did not warrant the large expenses.
Fill in the blank (Appropriate Filler),.exp: The word marginal is the most effective word, which can make the sentence meaningful. “The improvement made by changes in the system was marginal and did not warrant the large expenses.”

Fill in the blank (Appropriate Filler),.question: ৪৮) He is too _________ to be deceived easily.

Fill in the blank (Appropriate Filler),.question: ৪৯) There has been a _________ lack of efficiency in all the crucial areas of the working of public sector undertakings.
Fill in the blank (Appropriate Filler),.exp: The word conspicuous is the most effective word, which can make the sentence meaningful. “There has been a conspicuous lack of efficiency in all the crucial areas of the working of public sector undertakings.”

Fill in the blank (Appropriate Filler),.question: ৫০) Even at the risk of economics loss, he _________ refused to take the beaten track.
